proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.asset: Your ability means performing a task using your knowledge, understanding, and reasoning.
proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory guess: the shortened knowledge/understanding/reasoning description can retain completed play without supplied-engine searches even after both own tokens are removed. This asks whether descriptive content can work without possessive emphasis, given c398e61a30e0a's success and ccc65d3bb7326's generic-capacity failure. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial, or errored games do not support it.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. A paired difference is exploratory rather than proof of a semantic mechanism; matching outcomes do not establish equivalence.
proposal.ablation: Against the accompanying shortened-definition candidate, delete the two occurrences of own and their following spaces, changing no other asset bytes. Hold the opening, link, file presence/location, remaining original task, and actor settings fixed. Asset has 12 words, no title, and no trailing newline. This isolates possessive emphasis as a two-token deletion within the shortened definition; comparison directly to c398e61a30e0a also includes the shared clause deletion and is not a single-variable contrast. Count all remaining file words and link/target costs rather than treating the zero-visible-word opening change as free.
proposal.parent: c398e61a30e0a; matched shortened-definition candidate in this proposal
